name: ImageCanvas
description:
The accelerated view of the nearest editor. It fills its parent. The picture sits on a neutral
stage in every theme and direction, so nothing around it changes how its colours read.

Inside a Glass UX `PaneLayout` with overlay placement, Fit places the picture in the area the
floating panes leave clear, read from `--pane-covered-*`. A host can set those four properties on
any ancestor to keep its own floating content clear. Panning and zooming use the whole stage.
signature: ({ "aria-label": label, backend: prefer, className, children, onDocumentPointer }: ImageCanvasProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: backend
props.description: Which backend to prefer. Defaults to the best available.

props.name: children
props.description: Drawn over the picture. Elements marked `data-canvas-tool` take pointer drags from panning.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: onDocumentPointer
props.description: Pointer down, move, up and cancel samples in document pixels.
